sources.title: An insight into crop diversity, productivity and economics of shifting cultivation in Eastern India
sources.access: Publisher abstract and references; full text subscription-only. Journal society abstract is the same evidence family.
sources.scope: Niyamgiri hill slopes in Kalahandi and Rayagada, with holdings grouped by size.
sources.decision: Priority full-methods retrieval lead, not a verified village-level seed inventory.
unresolved: Names and selection of villages and households
Crop versus cultivar definitions and seed provenance
sources.not_adopted: Yield, income, soil-change and land-allotment claims; abstract does not supply enough methods for their use here.

sources.title: Evaluation of Productivity and Sustainability of Niyamgiri Village Agroecosystem, Eastern Region India
sources.field_period_reported: 2010–2015, with a preliminary village survey in 2010
sources.access: Extracted PDF text: methods p.2, village profile p.3, cropping discussion p.7 and Table 7 p.8. Screenshot requests for pp.2,3,7 failed; no visual table verification claimed.
sources.methods_scope: Eight accessible Bissam Cuttack-area villages, four uphill and four foothill; family-head questionnaires and field observations.
sources.decision: Historical comparison lead only. Cropping categories and village material-flow tables are not a current cultivar inventory. Village spelling matches to existing articles are unverified.
limits: No nutritional or economic totals imported.
Local crop-name identifications need independent botanical checking.
Broad judgements about communities and shifting cultivation are not adopted.
Study quality and numerical consistency have not been fully audited.

sources.title: Mainstreaming traditional varieties and on-farm conservation of crop diversity for sustainable finger millet cultivation in Odisha, India
sources.access: Publisher full text, especially Material and methods through Scientific data collection.
sources.scope: Trial of 13 traditional finger-millet varieties and seven checks at four Odisha test locations, including Rayagada; randomized blocks with three replications.
sources.decision: Useful regional source on trial design and seed provenance; inspected methods do not identify a Dongria village sample. Do not label the varieties as a Dongria inventory.
sources.next_route: The methods point to passport data and collections at the Koraput field gene bank and State Seed Testing Laboratory, Bhubaneswar. A village-linked accession record would be needed to establish provenance. No such record was retrieved.
sources.limits: Programme histories, trial results and actual household seed use remain different evidence types.

next_action: Prioritise a lawful full-text or author manuscript route for the Bhol paper; inspect its village table and methods before adding quantitative or cultivar claims. No purchase or outreach made.
article_changes: None. Existing illustrated manuscript and article collection remain current; retain 85% text-column image width.
